status: Disabled registry experiment verified; production runtime and retry behavior unchanged

implementation.ownership: One registry per isolated document; register before initial check, retain only bounded active operations and discovery state, release observers/timers/roots when the last operation ends. Pagehide disposes remaining work.
implementation.predicate: Uses the existing locator assertion wrapper and pinned complete _expectCore predicate; every notification resolves membership and checks the complete predicate again. No element identity or assertion truth cache.
implementation.detection: Shared MutationObserver and document/lifecycle events, requestAnimationFrame fallback for the broad supported selector/predicate dependencies, and a 100ms timer when frame scheduling is insufficient. This is an experimental policy, not a public timing contract.
implementation.discovery: Already-true checks do no discovery. Pending checks share an incremental TreeWalker pass over the document and known open roots, then inserted subtrees. Work is split into 512-node tasks; active operations, roots, queued subtrees and total visits are capped. Missed roots at a bound remain covered by full predicate fallback.
implementation.instrumentation: Opt-in counters distinguish predicate evaluations from discovery passes/visits; no intermediate operation events. Snapshot inspection is rejected when instrumentation is disabled.

observations.cleanup: All 24 cases on all three environments end with zero active conditions, observed roots, queued subtrees or scheduled timers/frames. Counters remain stable after a further 30ms. Three external watchdogs report no remaining processes and no cleanup signals.

remaining: Integrate descriptor preparation, exact session/context operation identity and registry lifecycle into the Rust engine behind a disabled experiment switch; do not change the supported predicate contract.

Preserve authoritative host monotonic deadlines, timely cancellation and bounded last-observation diagnostics, including blocked renderer, worker/driver death, stale documents and concurrent operations. The current renderer-only timeout/cancellation tests do not prove these host properties.
Bound mutation-record admission and evaluate mutation-heavy/fallback-heavy CPU behavior before enabling the registry. Native MutationObserver batch sizes are outside the explicit discovery queue cap.
Prove timer fallback under real suspended frame scheduling, CSS animation/font changes and high mutation load; retain exact discovery and predicate counters.
Run preparation-inclusive off/on and matched reference measurements without instrumentation and at matched resource budgets; no net performance benefit is established.
Complete remaining M2 APIs, the full S12 finish line and the S10 CBOR boundary; no milestone or release gate is completed by this prototype.
platformScope: Full current macOS Node 24 core suite; current registry-only tests on macOS Node 22 and emulated Linux Node 24. The prior full emulated Linux suite covers the unchanged production engine and adapter at its separately retained 133-source checkpoint. Native Linux CI/performance remains open.
